name: Meatball Pasta Stew
description: A savory stew with homemade meatballs, pasta, and a rich tomato-based sauce.
recipeIngredient: ¼ to ⅛ cup dry bread crumbs

recipeInstructions.text: Combine hamburger, egg, bread crumbs, onion, salt, mustard, and pepper to make meatballs. Shape into 1-inch balls.
Place meatballs on a greased baking sheet and bake at 350°F for 10 to 15 minutes, or until browned.
In a large pot, cook onion and garlic until tender.
Add flour and stir constantly for 1 minute.
Gradually add beef broth, stirring constantly until boiling.
Add tomato paste, undrained tomatoes, bay leaf, and thyme. Mix well.
Add meatballs, carrots, zucchini, peppers, and parsley. Simmer for 40 minutes.
Add cooked pasta and heat until hot.
Remove bay leaf before serving.

keywords: meatball stew, pasta stew, tomato-based sauce

_similar.name: Hamburger Pie
_similar.description: A savory pie made with ground beef, green beans, and tomato soup, topped with a layer of mashed potatoes and baked until golden.

recipeInstructions.text: Heat 4 Tbsp oil in a pan and brown the sliced onion.
Add the hamburger, salt, and pepper to the pan and brown the meat.
Add the cooked green beans and tomato soup to the meat mixture and mix well.
Transfer the mixture to a casserole dish.
Boil the potatoes until tender, then mash with warm milk and beaten egg.
Spoon the mashed potatoes in mounds over the top of the meat mixture in the casserole.
Bake at 350°F for 30 minutes.

_similar.name: Hawaiian Meatballs
_similar.description: A Hawaiian-inspired meatball recipe with a sweet and sour sauce, cooked in a pan and finished in the oven.

recipeInstructions.text: Mix the meat mixture together and shape into balls.
Dredge the meatballs in flour and brown in shortening on both sides.
Remove the meatballs from the pan and set aside.
Mix the dry sauce ingredients well, then stir in the wet ingredients.
Stir the sauce mixture into the fat in the pan and cook until thick and bubbly.
Return the meatballs to the pan, cover, and put in the oven to cook for ½ hour.

_similar.keywords: Hawaiian meatballs, sweet and sour sauce, oven-finished

_similar.name: Jelly Roll Style Meat Loaf
_similar.description: A creative meat loaf recipe shaped like a jelly roll, filled with mozzarella cheese and baked in a loaf pan.
recipeIngredient: ½ cup cracker crumbs or dry bread crumbs

recipeInstructions.text: Mix all ingredients except ground beef in a large bowl, using only 1 cup of mozzarella cheese.
Add ground beef and mix thoroughly with hands until just combined.
Shape the mixture into a 10x12 inch rectangle on waxed paper.
Sprinkle 2 cups of mozzarella cheese over the meat.
Roll up the mixture like a jelly roll using the waxed paper and press ends together to seal.
Place the foil-wrapped jelly roll in a meat loaf pan and bake in a 350°F oven for 1 hour.
Drain off fat and pour reserved tomato sauce on the roll.
Bake for an additional 15 minutes.
Let stand for 10 to 15 minutes before slicing.
Decorate with tomato slices and green parsley on a serving tray.

_similar.keywords: meat loaf, jelly roll, mozzarella cheese, baked

_similar.name: Chili Turkey
_similar.description: A hearty chili turkey dish made with ground turkey, kidney beans, and whole wheat spaghetti.

recipeInstructions.text: Heat oil in a large heavy pot over medium heat. Add onion and cook, stirring occasionally, until it starts to brown, about 8 to 10 minutes.
Add garlic and cook for 1 minute.
Add the turkey and cook, stirring to coarsely crumble until no longer pink, about 8 to 10 minutes.
Stir in chili powder, tomato paste, broth, cinnamon, cumin, salt, coriander, and oregano. Bring to a simmer.
Partially cover and cook, stirring occasionally, until the meat is tender and the broth is slightly thickened.
Meanwhile, pour the beans (with juice) into a microwaveable bowl. Microwave on high for 1 to 2 minutes or until heated through. Drain and cover to keep warm.
Cook the pasta as directed.
Place pasta on a plate, ladle chili over pasta, and top with beans, then with cheese.

_similar.keywords: chili turkey, ground turkey, kidney beans, whole wheat spaghetti

_similar.name: Cheeseburger Meat Loaf
_similar.description: A cheeseburger-inspired meatloaf with a cheddar cheese and pickle relish filling, topped with tomato sauce.

recipeInstructions.text: In a mixing bowl, combine ground beef, egg, bread crumbs, garlic salt, onion powder, salt, pepper, and seasoning salt. Mix well.
Mix chopped onion and tomato sauce together in a separate bowl.
Add half of the tomato sauce and onion mixture to the beef mixture and mix well.
Pack half of the beef mixture into a loaf pan.
Sprinkle shredded cheddar cheese and sweet pickle relish evenly over the top.
Pack the remaining beef mixture on top and press firmly.
Bake in a preheated oven at 350°F for 1 hour.
Carefully spoon off excess fat from the top.
Pour the remaining tomato sauce and onion mixture over the meatloaf.
Bake for an additional 15 minutes.
Let stand for about 5 minutes before inverting onto a heated serving platter if desired.

_similar.keywords: cheeseburger meatloaf, stuffed meatloaf, cheddar and pickle filling
